reason: Normally no reviews and no past clients is an instant no for me after last time, but here I don't pay a penny until the site is finished and I've seen it working on the preview link, so they can't take my money and vanish. I'd try it, cautiously, with the scope nailed down in writing first.
objection: They're in Kuwait with no reviews, so if it drags on or they disappear halfway I've lost weeks again and there's no one local to chase. And 'changes outside the scope cost extra' smells like where the bill creeps up, plus I want my domain in my name from day one, not handed over later.
would_change_my_mind: If the written scope was vague, or they wanted to register the domain in their own name, I'd walk away.
